body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 70710fc786532744cd57e1dd65aa677b03c75c66 -->
Review (Opus): clean

Read-only review of head `70710fc78` in a detached worktree. The worktree is removed.

**Test result**
- `ZOLA=zola 0.23.6 (zola.exe) PYTHONUTF8=1 python -m unittest discover -s site/tests -v`: 82 tests, OK.
- `cargo xtask catalog --check`: not run by this review. The PR body says that it passes.
- The branch merges cleanly with `origin/main` (`git merge-tree`).

**Test changes**
- `section_lead` skips one leading block only, and only when the block starts the section and has its end marker. The icon check then requires the icon as the first content. The reason is in `docs/decisions/3271-site-test-drift.md`.
- The MCP facts "no key entry form" and "no endpoint field" are in `automate/mcp.md` (lines 187-189) and `automate/ai.md`. They agree with 028495f5c, which added the transport.
- The label sources are correct. `tool_settings_grid.rs` draws Name, Type, Ball nose, Diameter, Flute length, Shank diameter, Spindle rpm and "Tool number" (line 272). `op_page/header.rs` draws Tool, Source and Coolant. The UI test `tool_properties.rs:239` asserts that the old "(0 = next free)" label is gone.
- The continuous 4-axis test still checks the shipped A travel: lines 185-192 read the machine file and the saved project (`saved_a["travel"]` is None). Only the read of the `docs/decisions/` file is removed, with a comment.
- `FAMILIES` adds `SlotUndercut` and `VCarve`.

**Content**
- The six icons are byte-identical to `assets/ui/` (SHA-256 equal). `site/static/icons/LICENSES.txt` is equal to `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` (`cmp`).
- The `rotariesBeforeTraverse` row agrees with `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` (line 64, #3100).
- The V-Carve section agrees with `vcarve_op.rs` and `vcarve_page.rs`: tool kind `Taper` ("chamfer mill"), Bottom Z 2 under Top Z, Flat clearing off, Floor stepover 0.25 shown only when on, and the three refusal texts. The text is our own. It copies no outside text.
- The PR body has `Changelog: none`, `Process change: no` and `Fixes #3271`. Nothing under `xtask/` or the other process files changes.

**Notes (not blockers)**
1. `site/content/guide/operations/operations-2d.md:502`: "the document stepdown" is not a setting of the app. The seed takes `Carried.stepdown` (default 5, `kinds.rs:63`), as the defaults paragraph at line 17 says. Write "5" to match the other sections.
2. `site/tests/test_guide_icons.py` `section_lead`: if the leading block has no end marker, `find` can match the end marker of a later block. The icon check then reads the content after that later block. This case is not probable, because xtask writes each block whole. A search for the end marker before the next start marker removes the gap.

Coordinator: this docs and test PR fixes the P2 #3271. It merges when it is reviewed (AGENTS.md: a docs-only PR). The review that this merge relies on is comment 7073329388 (Opus, clean, head 70710fc78; the site tests ran 82 tests, all OK). Its two notes are filed as P7 #3275. I flag it ready and merge it on head 70710fc78. Nothing is pushed after this flag.
